queries.query: INSERT INTO users (id, email, name, password, role, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :email, :name, :password, :role, :active, :createdAt, :updatedAt)
SELECT id, email, name, password, role, active, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = :email LIMIT 1
SELECT id, email, name, password, role, active, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1
UPDATE users SET password = :password, updated_at = :updatedAt WHERE id = :id
INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (id, user_id, token, expires_at, revoked, created_at) VALUES (:id, :userId, :token, :expiresAt, :revoked, :createdAt)
SELECT id, user_id, token, expires_at, revoked, created_at FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token = :token AND revoked = FALSE AND expires_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked = TRUE WHERE id = :id
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked = TRUE WHERE user_id = :userId AND revoked = FALSE
